caption.text: The lion and Florentine lily turn civic authority into a watchful animal presence. This nineteenth-century plaster cast also shows how Donatello’s emblem circulated far beyond its original public setting.

proposals.reason: A heraldic civic figure makes authority visible through an animal and its shield.

caption.text: Dalou gives an ordinary worker the gravity of a public monument. The rolled sleeve makes labor itself a sign of dignity and presence; this particular cast’s edition and holding collection remain unconfirmed.

proposals.reason: The worker figure expands the display of public status beyond rulers and civic emblems. Orsay is composition context, not a claim to the scanned cast.
